title: v0.3.1
body:
## What's Changed * Clarify Sepo template setup guidance by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/356 * Avoid duplicate model flags for session runs by @grp06 in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/357 * Mirror Codex OpenAI key into ACPX auth env by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/363 * Track setup check issues with the agent label by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/366 * Compact model display footer metadata by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/373 * Tighten dispatch triage prompt for discussion intent by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/371 * Use a dedicated prompt for repo updates by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/369 * Harden hosted OIDC auth retries by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/374 * Allow answer route inline review replies by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/376 * Add implicit follow-up intent routing by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/349 * Default model display metadata to visible by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/390 * Normalize Codex ACP model reasoning by @lolipopshock in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/388 * Decouple workflow guard test from root README by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/397 * Prepare Sepo 0.3.1 release by @sepo-agent-app[bot] in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/403 ## New Contributors * @grp06 made their first contribution in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/357 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1
This discussion was created from the release v0.3.1.
